blocks.title: From prompt to running app in three steps

items.title: Build it with AI
items.text: Make your app with Claude Code or any AI tool you like. Moon HQ doesn’t mind how it was written.

items.title: Say “deploy”
items.text: It goes live at its own address, with a database and automatic backups. No servers, no configuration.

items.title: Share it, sign in once
items.text: Invite people by email or open it to your whole organisation. Everyone uses the same Moon HQ login.

blocks.title: Everything around your app, handled quietly

items.title: One login everywhere
items.text: People sign in once and are recognised in every app they can access. Your apps never build their own login.

items.title: Passkeys, MFA and SSO
items.text: Strong sign-in without the setup: passkeys and authenticator codes for people, single sign-on for companies.

items.title: Its own address
items.text: Every app gets a clean web address, like habits.moonhq.app.

items.title: Database and backups
items.text: Each app has its own database, backed up automatically.

items.title: Sharing and roles
items.text: Share by email or with a whole organisation, and decide who can do what.

items.title: Sessions and audit log
items.text: See every active session, end any of them, and keep a record of who did what.

blocks.title: Built for makers. Ready for companies.

columns.title: For builders
